newsitem.title: USA: HBO & Co slides on rumor of report.
newsitem.headline: HBO & Co slides on rumor of report.

text.p: Shares of HBO & Co slid amid market rumors that a financial research firm issued a negative report on the health care information services company, analysts said.
Rumors circulated throughout the afternoon that the Center for Financial Research & Analysis in Maryland issued cautionary statements on HBO, analysts said.
A spokeswoman for the Center for Financial Research said no report had been issued, but said "we may have more to say at the end of the week." She declined further comment.
HBO & Co representatives could not be reached for comment on its share activity.
Despite HBO's stock slide Tuesday, analysts said HBO's fundamentals remained strong.
"They just reported solid earnings. They had a great quarter," said Dirk Godsey, an analyst with Hambrecht & Quist.
Last week, HBO reported first quarter earnings of $0.38 a share, beating Wall Street expectations of $0.33 a share. In the first quarter of 1996, HBO earned $0.24 a share.
HBO & Co fell five to 51-1/8, after hitting an intraday high of 57-5/8.
